title: Foundation tokens
goal: Create a restrained, reusable visual system for Wave 7 without changing BetterMakati's identity or adding new product functionality.
doctrine: Makati identity without turning pages into green wallpaper.
Gold is an accent, not a dominant surface color.
Prefer fewer, stronger shared visual patterns over one-off decoration.
Evidence and source context stay close to civic claims.
Photography must feel local and meaningful when W7-9 is reached; no false locality.
Accessibility and reduced-motion behavior remain non-negotiable.
sharedApplications: Body canvas and ink now use semantic surface/ink tokens.
Global container maximum width is tokenized.
Existing shared card rest/hover elevations use semantic shadow tokens.
Shared button and form-control radii use the control-radius token.
Section eyebrow gains the restrained gold identity rule already anticipated by print styling.
Reusable reading-measure, paper-surface, muted-surface and feature-rule utilities are available for later Wave 7 page-family work.
